big_case.notes: Emergency application to stay a nationwide-scope injunction against a presidential executive order restructuring mail-ballot administration, resolved weeks before the November 2026 midterms, with 23 states plus D.C. opposing 12 supporting states, heavy amicus participation, and full-Court referral. The grant changes election administration on the eve of a national election; among the highest-stakes shadow-docket matters of the Term.

leakage.notes: Forward cell: predicted 2026-08-16, application resolved 2026-08-24, so no outcome existed to retrieve. The captured log holds only three calls (two statpack reads and one call whose payload the harness redacted at capture as credential-shaped — read as removed text per the contract, not as outcome material). retrieval.md discloses a CourtListener MCP query (returned HTTP 429, nothing retrieved) and reads of five supremecourt.gov filing PDFs dated 2026-07-27 through 2026-08-12 that do not appear in the captured log — all pre-snapshot filings, none outcome-revealing, and the reasoning treats the application as pending throughout. The capture gap is flagged in the cell's flags.json as a data-quality note; it does not change the forward-mode verdict.
